summary: Added changelog.md entry for the Wizard Preselection API feature under v7.3.2, documenting WizardPreselection, WizardConfigurator, and the Step constructor merge fix.
Updated WizardPreselection.php setStepValue() @param $stepName to warn that the step name must exactly match the addStep() argument — addresses WP-005 code-review documentation-forward.
Updated Step.php constructor @param $data to document the merge-over-defaults semantics — confirms the WP-002 documentation-forward is present in the file.
Ran composer dump-autoload — exit 0, both WizardPreselection and WizardConfigurator are resolvable via autoloader.
Ran phpunit --filter Wizard — 16/16 tests pass, 62 assertions, exit 0. No regressions.

Delegated CTX regeneration to ctx-architect: ctx generate ran successfully (exit 0, 97 documents). No context.yaml config changes were needed — existing Admin module-context.yaml already covered Wizard/*.php. .context/modules/admin/architecture-wizard.md now reflects the updated setStepValue @param doc.

comments.note: [documentation-forward addressed] WizardPreselection.php setStepValue(): @param $stepName now carries an explicit coupling warning — the step name must verbatim match the addStep() argument in the target wizard's _initSteps(). This was forwarded by the WP-005 code reviewer as the most likely silent-failure footgun for API consumers.

[documentation-forward addressed] Step.php constructor @param $data: now documents the merge-over-getDefaultData() semantics, explaining that defaults fill absent keys and supplied values override defaults. This was the WP-002 documentation-forward item. The WP-002 documentation pipeline claimed to have applied this, but the note was absent from the file; applied here.
